# Copilot instructions

This is a Lens Studio project targeting SPECS. The CLAD toolkit (ls-clad) is installed for GitHub Copilot:

- For any Lens Studio, Specs, or Lens task, load the `lens-studio-router` skill first. It checks Lens Studio and MCP readiness and routes the work.
- Follow `lens-studio-field-notes` for the Copilot-specific rules: MCP tool naming, subagents, asking the user, and progress tracking. Read "ls-clad:<name>" as the bare skill or agent name `<name>`.
- Use the `lens-studio` MCP tools for all editor work. If they fail to connect, Lens Studio is not open with this project. Stop and ask the user to open it instead of working around it.
- Do not edit files under `.github/skills/`, `.github/agents/`, or `.github/clad/agent-references/`. They are generated by `.github/clad/sync-clad.py`.
